name: reading-time-left
title: Reading time left
description: A reading-time readout that counts down as you read an article, from its real word count, ending in a quiet Done. Screen readers hear the total once and are never interrupted.
docs: Point target at the article with a ref or a CSS selector: its words are counted and the reader's position through it drives the readout. It shows the total at the top ("3 min read"), counts the minutes left, and ends on Done. It redraws at most once a second and is never announced; a screen reader gets the total once. It renders no text on the server. It pairs with Scroll progress rather than replacing it. Translate it with labels (use {minutes} for the number) or take over completely with format.
